title: Corporate Governance Tech Summit (SF) — Eric opens with fireside on Incorruptible, moderated by Evan Epstein
summary: Pennant AI and the Northern California, Hawaii and Nevada chapter of the Society for Corporate Governance ran the Corporate Governance Tech Summit at WorkOS HQ in San Francisco. Eric opened it, and the rest of the agenda covered reincorporation out of Delaware, AI in the boardroom and shareholder activism.
blockquote: Opening fireside with Eric Ries — NYT best-selling author of "The Lean Startup" and founder of the Long-Term Stock Exchange — on the governance lessons in his new book, "Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad and How Great Companies Stay Great". Moderated by Evan Epstein, Founder of Boardroom Governance. Every guest will take home a copy of Eric's new book.
